item.title: ‘Silent Friend’ Trailer: Tony Leung & Léa Seydoux Star In Ildikó Enyedi’s Touching German-Set Drama That Spans Multiple Time Periods
item.description: Hungarian filmmaker Ildikó Enyedi is back with their latest feature effort, “Silent Friend,” and we have a new trailer for the upcoming drama. The title refers to the tree at the centre of the film, a ginkgo tree, as we get to explore three different timelines connected to this majestic tree. We see actors such as Hong Kong star Tony Leung, Luna Wedler, Enzo Brumm, and Léa Seydoux among the cast of characters.
